note: UN-DEFERRED 2026-08-28 (owner directive TG-128: 'deliver groundnet; solve yourself all blockers'). Under active implementation, built DORMANT + gated, task by task, in build order 1 -> {2,5} -> {3,7} -> 4 -> 6 -> 8. LANDED so far: the SCITT statement layer — T-021-1 (envelope.go/payload.go/doc.go) and T-021-2 (pseudonym.go/signature.go), real veraison/go-cose COSE_Sign1; the A1 generalizable projection (core/trace/layers.go, spec/020 REQ-2017); T-021-5 (adapter.go/seam.go — the typed Emit/Ingest seam sourcing only the generalizable layer, subordinate-not-authority Ingest); and T-021-3 (translog.go/provenance.go — the local transparency-log Receipt as a third append-only hash-chain reusing core/audit anchors, + the atomic replay guard RecordIfNew). and T-021-7 (membership.go/posture.go — opt-in default-off Posture, org-admin-gated + audited enablement, consumption never gated behind contribution, unrecallable governed record). and T-021-6 (ingest.go/regraduate.go — the subordinate-not-authority ReGraduator: a foreign chunk lands as a no-authority hint at graduation LevelApprove and earns authority ONLY via LOCAL verified-clean runs through the consumer's own core/policy graduation ladder, never inheriting producer trust). All unit-tested, incl. the FULL in-process e2e (TestFullE2ERegraduation: node A Emit -> node B Ingest -> land subordinate -> local re-graduation) with the real translog + ladder. Acceptance scenarios bind as each task completes; until bound they stay @pending, tracked as declared debt in acceptance/_test_mapping.json, so tasks with landed code sit at 'pending' until their scenarios are bound and they flip to 'completed'. WIRE ENVELOPE: the canonical groundnet SCITT profile (RFC 9943; products/ground-net/spec, authoritative) — envelope.go/signature.go/translog.go implement the SCITT Signed Statement + COSE signature + Transparency Service, not a custom envelope. The whole package is DORMANT (unwired, seam default-off); while unwired it is outside every binary's reachability graph, so deadcode-gate does not analyze it (Phase-C wiring brings it in).
